title: Unique descent of underlying morphisms of descent data
statement: Let a:X→S and r:X′→X be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with r a singleton fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let F:DD(a)→DD(r≫a) [def-galois-scheme-descent-data-category] and maps q_A exhibit cartesian squares [def-pc-fibre-product] and base change of the data [def-pd-descent-datum]. For any A,B and morphism β:F(A)→F(B), there is a unique morphism α:A.V→B.V over X such that q_A≫α.left=β.hom.left≫q_B. No compatibility of α with the original descent data is asserted.

source.place: 0241, first overlap argument and descent of the underlying morphism via 02W0

proof.text: Pull back the singleton fpqc cover r along A.V.hom using its chosen cartesian square. Subcanonicality of the fpqc topology implies that q_A is an effective epimorphism.

For g1,g2 with equal composites to A.V, their base points f1,f2 have equal composites to X. Base-change compatibility and the diagonal identity identify transport of g1 with g2, by the cartesian-square universal property. Apply beta.commutes and base-change compatibility for B; the diagonal identity on B gives equality of g1 beta q_B and g2 beta q_B.

Apply EffectiveEpi.desc to beta.hom.left composed with q_B. Its factorization equation gives reconstruction. Cancel the epimorphism q_A to check that the descended map is over X and to prove uniqueness in Over X.
